projects.name: FallacyRAG
projects.summary: Retrieval-augmented fallacy detection and classification in political debates that guides the retrieval strategy with argumentative relations (under review at EACL 2027).

projects.name: RooseBERT
projects.summary: Domain-adapted language model for political debates, pretrained on 11GB of debates with multi-GPU training on the Jean Zay HPC cluster. Released four model variants, a sentence encoder, and the RooseDebates corpus on Hugging Face, with 300+ monthly downloads (WI-IAT 2026).

projects.name: DispuTOOL
projects.summary: Transforming my PhD project into a web app to ground my research contributions in real-world usability.
